packageRules.description: go.mod's replace pins kustomize to the version that kustomize-controller pins, as its comment says. Renovate lists each new version of these two, in the require lines and in the replace, on the Dependency Dashboard, and opens a pull request only once it is approved there. Approve it when the kustomize-controller of the e2e's Flux moves to that version, and change the replace in the same pull request: a bump of the require lines alone drags k8s.io/kube-openapi onto sigs.k8s.io/structured-merge-diff/v7, which k8s.io/apimachinery v0.37 cannot use (#13, #15).

The tools of hack/tools/install.sh, in a pull request of their own, apart from group:allNonMajor: a pin that does not match its download fails install.sh, and so CI's jobs, until it is fixed. CI's lint job checks every pin, for amd64 and arm64.
kubectl and helm: Renovate cannot read the SHA-256 of their downloads, so it lists each new version on the Dependency Dashboard and opens a pull request only once it is approved there.
prBodyNotes: Renovate changed the version on each line of kubectl and helm in `hack/tools/install.sh`, not the SHA-256. Copy each from the project's published checksum, for amd64 and arm64: `https://dl.k8s.io/release/VERSION/bin/linux/ARCH/kubectl.sha256` and `https://get.helm.sh/helm-VERSION-linux-ARCH.tar.gz.sha256sum`. CI's lint job fails until both match.

customManagers.description: hack/tools/install.sh: kind, flux and cosign, whose downloads are GitHub release assets. Renovate updates each line's version and its SHA-256 together.
hack/tools/install.sh: kubectl and helm, whose downloads are not on GitHub. Renovate updates each line's version only: its SHA-256 is copied by hand.
